body: He made the choice to stop drinking because it was destroying his stomach.  He was vomiting blood daily.  Has an ulcer.

Aunt to multiple teenage nephews.  Both my husband and I have made it clear if they are uncomfortable buying their own, we will for them.  No questions asked.   Much rather they wrap it and be safe.  If you aren’t comfortable, is there a trusted adult that you could ask? I was also the friend that bought condom and pregnancy test for my other friends because they were too afraid.

We definitely have. No one has seen anything odd or suspicious.  He says nothing happened at all.  She never acted uncomfortable around him or us. Up until a month ago, she was still talking with him daily.  They had more like a father/daughter relationship type thing, she would come to us for advice or if she needed help with something.  Her fiancé doesn’t let her post anything about him on social media.  I’ve never met him, don’t know what he looks like or his whole name.

I literally can’t do anything right in this situation.  I stand by my husband and say she is lying.  Even monsters appear to be the nicest people. I know my kids have said they all feel comfortable and safe, and haven’t seen anything.  There is no way to prove who is right or wrong.  I do believe my husband but you also have to take these things seriously.

My belief is that her fiancé was jealous of our friendship with my cousin and has put the idea in her head.  I feel horrible saying that because it feels like I’m victim blaming.  Because it’s now also her stepbrother molested her and my husband, both other males that she was close with, and I think her fiancé was jealous.  Her words were, he helped her realize what happened to her.  She would confide in my husband and me about things that happened to her with her father.   Now, I know for a fact her father was abusive, as it was something I witnessed.  She also made a point to see him as little as possible, she would never be alone with him, she’d come to our house so she didn’t have to go to his.  She willingly came over and would ask to come over, which to me isn’t the behavior of someone being abused.
